wa_mount_prophet_east.why: Northern Pickets zone file propagated onto Mount Prophet, which stands on the EAST side of the Big Beaver valley opposite the Pickets. This route leaves the Big Beaver Trail at Thirtynine Mile Creek (~5 mi up) and its own prose says Luna Camp is ~5 mi FARTHER up-valley and belongs to the separate Southwest Rib route, not this one. Every other camp is on the Access Creek, Wiley Ridge, Whatcom Pass or Hannegan approaches to peaks on the other side of the valley. Nothing in the list is on this route's line.
